# GENERATED by tools/gen_civilian_allocation.py - edit that, not this.
# Civilian factory allocation - the mod's replacement for consumer goods.
#
# HOW IT TAKES OVER. The engine decides consumer goods by itself and never
# lets them drop below 10% of a country's factories. wif_defines.lua drops
# that floor to 0%, and wif_cg_neutraliser cancels every consumer goods
# modifier the country has, so the engine is left keeping just ONE factory on
# goods (MINIMUM_NUMBER_OF_FACTORIES_TAKEN_BY_CONSUMER_GOODS_VALUE = 1, kept
# so the construction tab's consumer goods row - where the arrow lives - never
# vanishes). Every other factory the country puts on goods, resources or
# trains is taken through civilian_factory_use, which is the same modifier the
# mod's spirits already use to occupy civs.
#
# WHAT "REQUIRED" IS. What the engine WOULD have taken: total factories times
# (expected value + factor), floored at 10% and at 1. That is the formula
# vanilla's own script uses for the consumer goods share
# (SWE_calc_communist_folkhemmet in SWE_scripted_effects.txt adds the two
# modifiers together).
#
# THE NEUTRALISER is a fixed -1 on both consumer goods modifiers, which takes
# any real share well below zero, so the engine falls to its minimum of one.
# It is a constant on purpose. The first version cancelled the country's
# values exactly through variables and read them back with modifier@, but the
# engine only refreshes those totals on its daily tick: a second calculation
# on the same day read stale totals, doubled the requirement, and automatic
# redistribution poured every civilian factory into goods. A constant can be
# recognised whether it has been applied yet or not - see
# wif_cg_compute_required.
#
# THE POOL. Every civilian factory, less other national projects - see
# wif_cg_refresh_pool. It is only re-read on days this system has not changed
# its own factory use (flag wif_cg_touched): the engine refreshes modifier
# totals on its daily tick, so a re-read straight after a change would
# subtract the wrong amount.
#
# Country variables (all wif_cg_*):
#   on_<compartment>   factories in each compartment; on_construction is the
#                      remainder and never set by hand
#   pool, required, balance (= on_goods - required), deficit, debt_ratio
#   auto               1 = automatic redistribution ticked
#   use                civilian_factory_use currently applied
#   train_ic           IC carried towards the next train

wif_cg_compute_required = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_e = modifier@consumer_goods_expected_value }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_f = modifier@consumer_goods_factor }

	# Take the neutraliser's -1 back out, but only once the engine has applied
	# it. No economy law sets the expected value below zero, so anything under
	# -0.5 means the -1 is in the total.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_e < -0.5 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cg_e = 1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cg_f = 1 }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_share = wif_cg_e }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cg_share = wif_cg_f }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_share min = 0.1 max = 1 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_required = num_of_factories }
	multiply_variable = { wif_cg_required = wif_cg_share }
	round_variable = wif_cg_required
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_cg_required min = 1 }
}

wif_cg_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cg_init } }
		set_country_flag = wif_cg_init
		set_variable = { wif_cg_auto = 1 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_auto_frame = 2 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_construction = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_steel = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_tungsten = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_chromium = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_aluminium = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_trains = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_use = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_train_ic = 0 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_cg_neutraliser }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_cg_allocation }

		wif_cg_compute_required = yes
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_required }
	}
}

# The pool is every civilian factory the country has, less what OTHER
# national projects (spirits, decisions) hold through civilian_factory_use.
#
# NOT num_of_available_civilian_factories. That is the number of IDLE
# factories - the ones not working on anything - so the first version's pool
# shrank by every factory the construction queue used, and with a full queue
# the window showed construction 0 and no room to move anything.
#
# Factories spent buying resources on the market are not visible to script
# and are not subtracted.
wif_cg_refresh_pool = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cg_touched } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_other = modifier@civilian_factory_use }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_other = wif_cg_use }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_other min = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_other_projects = wif_cg_other }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_pool = num_of_civilian_factories }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_pool = wif_cg_other }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_cg_pool min = 0 }
	}
}

# Sums the hand-filled compartments and derives construction from the pool.
wif_cg_sum_assigned = {
	set_variable = { wif_cg_assigned = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_assigned = wif_cg_on_goods }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_assigned = wif_cg_on_steel }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_assigned = wif_cg_on_tungsten }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_assigned = wif_cg_on_chromium }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_assigned = wif_cg_on_aluminium }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_assigned = wif_cg_on_trains }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_on_construction = wif_cg_pool }
	subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_construction = wif_cg_assigned }
}

# Keeps the compartments legal and runs the automatic redistribution.
wif_cg_normalise = {
	wif_cg_sum_assigned = yes

	if = {
		# The AI pays exactly what is required and builds with the rest.
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_required }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_steel = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_tungsten = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_chromium = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_aluminium = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_trains = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Automatic redistribution: raise goods to the requirement, taking
		# from trains and the resources first and construction last.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { wif_cg_auto = 1 }
			check_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods < wif_cg_required }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_required }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_on_goods }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_trains }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_trains = wif_cg_take }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_aluminium }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_aluminium = wif_cg_take }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_chromium }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_chromium = wif_cg_take }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_tungsten }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_tungsten = wif_cg_take }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_steel }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_steel = wif_cg_take }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
		wif_cg_sum_assigned = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_construction }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_need }
			add_to_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
		}
	}

	# More assigned than the pool holds (factories lost, bombed, traded away):
	# hand the overshoot back, trains and resources first, goods last.
	wif_cg_sum_assigned = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_on_construction < 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_on_construction }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_trains }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_trains = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_aluminium }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_aluminium = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_chromium }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_chromium = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_tungsten }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_tungsten = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_steel }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_steel = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_need > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_on_goods }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = 1 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_need }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_need = wif_cg_take }
	}
	}

	# The engine always keeps one factory on goods, so goods never reads 0.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods < 1 }
			check_variable = { wif_cg_pool > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = 1 }
	}
	wif_cg_sum_assigned = yes
}

# Window layout: one icon per factory, filling the 5 x 3 grid like a vanilla
# production line and staying full past 15. The exact count is on the
# line's top bar.
wif_cg_layout = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_n = wif_cg_on_goods }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_n min = 0 max = 15 }
	resize_array = { array = wif_cg_icons_goods value = 1 size = wif_cg_n }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_n = wif_cg_on_construction }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_n min = 0 max = 15 }
	resize_array = { array = wif_cg_icons_construction value = 1 size = wif_cg_n }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_n = wif_cg_on_steel }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_n min = 0 max = 15 }
	resize_array = { array = wif_cg_icons_steel value = 1 size = wif_cg_n }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_n = wif_cg_on_tungsten }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_n min = 0 max = 15 }
	resize_array = { array = wif_cg_icons_tungsten value = 1 size = wif_cg_n }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_n = wif_cg_on_chromium }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_n min = 0 max = 15 }
	resize_array = { array = wif_cg_icons_chromium value = 1 size = wif_cg_n }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_n = wif_cg_on_aluminium }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_n min = 0 max = 15 }
	resize_array = { array = wif_cg_icons_aluminium value = 1 size = wif_cg_n }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_n = wif_cg_on_trains }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_n min = 0 max = 15 }
	resize_array = { array = wif_cg_icons_trains value = 1 size = wif_cg_n }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_gui_dirty = 1 }
}

# Turns the compartments into modifier values and GUI layout.
wif_cg_apply = {
	wif_cg_sum_assigned = yes

	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_old_use = wif_cg_use }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_use = wif_cg_assigned }
	subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_use = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_cg_use min = 0 }
	# Any change to what this system holds makes the engine's totals stale
	# until its daily tick, so the pool must not be re-read today.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_cg_use = wif_cg_old_use } } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = wif_cg_touched days = 1 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_cg_res_steel = wif_cg_on_steel }
	multiply_variable = { wif_cg_res_steel = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_res_tungsten = wif_cg_on_tungsten }
	multiply_variable = { wif_cg_res_tungsten = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_res_chromium = wif_cg_on_chromium }
	multiply_variable = { wif_cg_res_chromium = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_res_aluminium = wif_cg_on_aluminium }
	multiply_variable = { wif_cg_res_aluminium = 0.1 }

	# Trains this compartment makes a week, for the window.
	set_variable = { wif_cg_train_rate = wif_cg_on_trains }
	multiply_variable = { wif_cg_train_rate = 12.25 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_tech = wartime_train }
		divide_variable = { wif_cg_train_rate = 50 }
	}
	else = {
		divide_variable = { wif_cg_train_rate = 70 }
	}

	set_variable = { wif_cg_balance = wif_cg_on_goods }
	subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_balance = wif_cg_required }

	set_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_stability = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_war_support = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_construction = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_pen_weekly = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_pen_output = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_deficit = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_debt_ratio = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_balance > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_stability = wif_cg_balance }
		multiply_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_stability = 0.0001 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_war_support = wif_cg_balance }
		multiply_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_war_support = 0.0001 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_construction = wif_cg_balance }
		multiply_variable = { wif_cg_bonus_construction = 0.00001 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_balance < 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_deficit = wif_cg_balance }
		multiply_variable = { wif_cg_deficit = -1 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_debt_ratio = wif_cg_deficit }
		divide_variable = { wif_cg_debt_ratio = wif_cg_required }

		set_variable = { wif_cg_pen_weekly = wif_cg_deficit }
		multiply_variable = { wif_cg_pen_weekly = -0.01 }

		# Past 50% debt every further factory short costs output.
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_half = wif_cg_required }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_cg_half = 0.5 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_over = wif_cg_deficit }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_over = wif_cg_half }
		round_temp_variable = wif_cg_over
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_over > 0 } }
			set_variable = { wif_cg_pen_output = wif_cg_over }
			multiply_variable = { wif_cg_pen_output = -0.01 }
		}
	}

	# For the window: one stability and one war support figure each. A
	# surplus gives a flat bonus, a deficit a weekly loss; only one is set.
	set_variable = { wif_cg_out_stability = wif_cg_bonus_stability }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_out_stability = wif_cg_pen_weekly }
	set_variable = { wif_cg_out_war_support = wif_cg_bonus_war_support }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_out_war_support = wif_cg_pen_weekly }

	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes

	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		wif_cg_layout = yes
	}
}

# Weekly, every country.
wif_cg_refresh = {
	wif_cg_init = yes
	wif_cg_compute_required = yes

	# Saves started on the first version can hold an inflated goods figure
	# from its doubled requirement; reset it once.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cg_v2 } }
		set_country_flag = wif_cg_v2
		set_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_required }
	}
	wif_cg_refresh_pool = yes
	wif_cg_normalise = yes
	wif_cg_apply = yes
}

wif_cg_weekly = {
	wif_cg_refresh = yes

	# Trains: the compartment banks IC and delivers whole trains.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_on_trains > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_ic = wif_cg_on_trains }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_cg_ic = 12.25 }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cg_train_ic = wif_cg_ic }
		if = {
			limit = { has_tech = wartime_train }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_cost = 50 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_cost = 70 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_rem = wif_cg_train_ic }
		modulo_temp_variable = { wif_cg_rem = wif_cg_cost }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_count = wif_cg_train_ic }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_count = wif_cg_rem }
		divide_temp_variable = { wif_cg_count = wif_cg_cost }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_count > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_tech = wartime_train }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_2 amount = wif_cg_count producer = ROOT }
			}
			else = {
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = wif_cg_count producer = ROOT }
			}
			set_variable = { wif_cg_train_ic = wif_cg_rem }
		}
	}

	# Deep in debt: the ruling party pays for it.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_debt_ratio > 0.25 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_government = democratic }
			add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = -0.01 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_government = communism }
			add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = -0.01 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_government = fascism }
			add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = -0.01 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_government = neutrality }
			add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = -0.01 }
		}
	}
}

# --- window clicks ---------------------------------------------------------

wif_cg_after_click = {
	set_country_flag = { flag = wif_cg_touched days = 1 value = 1 }
	wif_cg_apply = yes
}

wif_cg_toggle_window = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_cg_window_open }
		clr_country_flag = wif_cg_window_open
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = wif_cg_window_open
		wif_cg_refresh = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_gui_dirty = 1 }
}

wif_cg_toggle_auto = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cg_auto = 1 } }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_auto = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_auto_frame = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_cg_auto = 1 }
		set_variable = { wif_cg_auto_frame = 2 }
		wif_cg_normalise = yes
	}
	wif_cg_after_click = yes
}

# wif_cg_amount (temp) factories in from construction / back out to it.
wif_cg_add_goods = {
	wif_cg_sum_assigned = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_amount }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_on_construction }
	add_to_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
	wif_cg_after_click = yes
}

wif_cg_sub_goods = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_room = wif_cg_on_goods }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cg_room = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cg_take = wif_cg_amount }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cg_take min = 0 max = wif_cg_room }
	subtract_from_variable = { wif_cg_on_goods = wif_cg_take }
	wif_cg_after_click = yes
}
